contracts.requirement: All imported upstream sources MUST be immutable-pinned before materialization.
Khronos components are providers, validators or interchange implementations; none becomes an FA3 authority.
HRB remains exclusive host resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority.
Vulkan capability use MUST be selected from live feature/profile evidence, never GPU marketing name alone.
SPIR-V validation MUST fail closed before promoted shader execution.
glTF/KTX are interchange boundaries and MUST NOT replace native FA3 or integrated-application project files.
OpenXR, OpenCL, ANARI, OpenVX and NNEF adapters MUST remain optional/replaceable unless a bound capability explicitly requires them.
No silent CPU/GPU/provider/backend fallback is permitted after provider selection.
CPU-only FA3 conformance remains valid when no accelerator runtime is present.
Physical current-host PASS requires executable evidence; static/reference validation cannot promote runtime status.
